===== BEGIN H41_design.txt =====
H41 kF qsearch lightweight TT probe use (source hunk2277-2283), original r15d qsearch1790 onward opened. Unit one reached qsearch probe after draw/maxply/mate-window early returns. Counting-only TT method snapshots preprobe cluster under existing stripe lock/lease then old H18 scalar reference operates PRIVATE copy with generation refresh, first-empty/min-age replacement. No second real probe, no sampling writes or old counter hooks. Actual probe runs once. Fieldwise compare hit,cluster,slot, key32, full Movefrom/to/promotion/flags,score,eval,depth,gen_bound,rule50; padding deliberately not semantic. Compare consumer-derived move,normalizedscore,bound,pv from old formulas on reference. White private referencehit flip guarantees difference via hit field even if derived tuple coincides. Classes colour/pristine hit/near50/owned.
Shared cluster-index/hash formulas and existing H18 scalar reference, TTEntry score_usable/mate conversion helpers; no independently proven TT internals or legality. T1 snapshot-beforeprobe assumes no concurrent mutation between locks, matching measured workload; locking path/multiworker generality not established. Counting patch assumes existing SPD_TT_NOTLS=1 configuration. H18/H82 earlier wholeprobe evidence remains related; new check specifically covers qsearch consumer and full Move flags.
Forecast proxy H86 allstophelpercalls, qsearch subset excludes earlier returns: S1 6m..18m,S2 2m..6m,S3 9m..27m. Informed approximate, no new native probe.

===== END H41_design.txt =====

===== BEGIN H40_design.txt =====
H40 one supported qsearch entry consumer transition. Snapshot aborted flag, local/extra nodes, node budget/flag, fast eligibility and external stop BEFORE actual check_node_or_periodic_stop. Actual helper executes once, retaining old H86 diagnostic unchanged. Pure original reference: periodic-or-node-specified gate, then external-stop or aggregate-node-limit predicate, restricted sole main/no-parent/no-clock/no-ponder and FORGE_TEST_CLOCK_STOP=0. Expected aborted is pre-aborted OR old stop result. Observe exactly once at aborted return (before any increment) or after actual ++local_nodes on continuation. Compare actual aborted and expected node count pre+(not expected aborted).
Support excludes helper/multiworker/parent, managed/hard clocks, empty reserve, ponder and compiled test-clock stop. Before/after relaxed external-stop samples must agree; mismatched observations skipped. No second should_stop or elapsed_ms call. Stable samples do not rule out transient ABA or prove scheduler/concurrentstop correctness. Actual publication cadence and reason flag not newly compared here (related H86 evidence); no full worker-state equivalence claim.
Classes White/Black, pre-aborted/clear, stopped/continued, fast/ordinary, periodic/nonperiodic each partition supported uses. Unsupported and unstable-stop skips counted separately, never matches. WRONG20 flips private expected aborted Boolean only White; expected node delta derived from faulty Boolean, actual state untouched. Control requires strictsubset. It tests callsite abort/increment consumption beyond H86 helper Boolean checking, not qsearch later evaluation/TT behavior.
Forecast uses only previous H86 combined main+qsearch entry ceilings: S1 16543291, S2 5612621, S3 27127788. Estimated qsearch fraction gives bands6m..17m,2m..5.7m,9.1m..27.3m; fractions are assumptions, not measured new counts. Old35 counters and strictcanonical fields except time/nps must remain identical.

===== END H40_design.txt =====

===== BEGIN H40_cross_review.txt =====
Readonly H40 review PASS versus r15d qsearch1768 onward and should_stop1537-1583. Supported sole-main/no-parent/nonponder/no-clock domain makes original totalnodes local+extra. Original periodic-or-nodeflag gate and stable sharedstop/budget determine abort; priorabort preserved. Actual helper once, observation once before abortedreturn or after nodeincrement. Unsupported/stoptransition separate skips. H86 untouched. White private expectedabort flip guaranteed mismatch. Does not prove sharednodes publication, stopped_by_nodes sticky reason, clock behavior or ABA externalstop races.

===== END H40_cross_review.txt =====
